import AlgebraicJacobian.Descent.GaloisQuotientOverlap
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0GaloisAction

/-!
# The quotient-side bridge for finite Galois descent of Picard zero

A specified finite Galois quotient represents equivariant maps after base
change.  This file records that statement in the over-category.  It is the
scheme-theoretic half of descending a representative of `pic0TypeFunctor`.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits
open AlgebraicGeometry

namespace AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent

/-- An equivariant map from the finite-Galois base change of an object over
`Spec K` to a semilinearly acted `L`-scheme. -/
structure GaloisEquivariantOver
    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
    (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)
    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))) where
  hom : pullback T.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L))) ⟶ X
  commutes : hom ≫ f =
    pullback.snd T.hom (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K L)))
  equivariant : (pullbackSemilinearGalAction K L T.hom).IsEquivariant rho hom

namespace GaloisEquivariantOver

variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
  {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
  (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)

/-- Pull an equivariant map back along a morphism over `Spec K`. -/
noncomputable def precomp
    {T T' : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))} (a : T' ⟶ T)
    (h : GaloisEquivariantOver rho T) : GaloisEquivariantOver rho T' where
  hom := pullbackBaseChange K L T.hom T'.hom a.left a.w ≫ h.hom
  commutes := by
    rw [Category.assoc, h.commutes, pullbackBaseChange_snd]
  equivariant := SemilinearGalAction.isEquivariant_pullbackBaseChange_comp
    T.hom T'.hom rho h.equivariant a.left a.w

@[ext]
theorem ext {T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))}
    {h h' : GaloisEquivariantOver rho T} (hh : h.hom = h'.hom) : h = h' := by
  cases h
  cases h'
  cases hh
  rfl

end GaloisEquivariantOver

namespace GaloisQuotientWitness

variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
  {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
  {rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f}
  {Y : Scheme.{u}} {g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)}

/-- A finite-Galois quotient witness represents equivariant maps after base
change, with no affineness assumption on the test object. -/
noncomputable def overHomEquiv (w : GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y g)
    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))) :
    (T ⟶ Over.mk g) ≃ GaloisEquivariantOver rho T where
  toFun a :=
    { hom := pullbackBaseChange K L g T.hom a.left a.w ≫ w.e.hom
      commutes := by
        rw [Category.assoc, w.over, pullbackBaseChange_snd]
      equivariant := SemilinearGalAction.isEquivariant_pullbackBaseChange_comp
        g T.hom rho w.equivariant a.left a.w }
  invFun h :=
    Over.homMk
      (w.universal T.left T.hom h.hom h.commutes h.equivariant).choose.1
      (w.universal T.left T.hom h.hom h.commutes h.equivariant).choose.2
  left_inv a := by
    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    let h := pullbackBaseChange K L g T.hom a.left a.w ≫ w.e.hom
    let hw := w.universal T.left T.hom h
      (by
        dsimp [h]
        rw [Category.assoc, w.over, pullbackBaseChange_snd])
      (by
        dsimp [h]
        exact SemilinearGalAction.isEquivariant_pullbackBaseChange_comp
          g T.hom rho w.equivariant a.left a.w)
    have ha : pullbackBaseChange K L g T.hom a.left a.w ≫ w.e.hom = h := rfl
    have heq : hw.choose = ⟨a.left, a.w⟩ :=
      hw.unique hw.choose_spec.1 ha
    exact congrArg Subtype.val heq
  right_inv h := by
    apply GaloisEquivariantOver.ext rho
    exact (w.universal T.left T.hom h.hom h.commutes h.equivariant).choose_spec.1

/-- The quotient universal-property equivalence commutes with precomposition
in the category of schemes over `Spec K`. -/
theorem overHomEquiv_precomp (w : GaloisQuotientWitness rho Y g)
    {T T' : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))} (a : T' ⟶ T)
    (b : T ⟶ Over.mk g) :
    w.overHomEquiv T' (a ≫ b) =
      GaloisEquivariantOver.precomp rho a (w.overHomEquiv T b) := by
  apply GaloisEquivariantOver.ext rho
  change pullbackBaseChange K L g T'.hom (a.left ≫ b.left) _ ≫ w.e.hom =
    pullbackBaseChange K L T.hom T'.hom a.left a.w ≫
      (pullbackBaseChange K L g T.hom b.left b.w ≫ w.e.hom)
  rw [pullbackBaseChange_comp K L g T.hom T'.hom b.left b.w a.left a.w,
    Category.assoc]

end GaloisQuotientWitness

namespace StableAffineOpen

variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L]
  {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)}
  (rho : SemilinearGalAction K L X f)

/-- Under the orbit-in-an-affine-open hypothesis, the glued invariant-ring
quotient represents equivariant maps after finite Galois base change. -/
noncomputable def gluedQuotientOverHomEquiv
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L] [rho.OrbitsInAffineOpen]
    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))) :
    (T ⟶ gluedQuotientOver rho) ≃ GaloisEquivariantOver rho T :=
  (gluedGaloisQuotientWitness rho).toGaloisQuotientWitness.overHomEquiv T

/-- The glued-quotient equivalence is natural under precomposition. -/
theorem gluedQuotientOverHomEquiv_precomp
    [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L] [rho.OrbitsInAffineOpen]
    {T T' : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))} (a : T' ⟶ T)
    (b : T ⟶ gluedQuotientOver rho) :
    gluedQuotientOverHomEquiv rho T' (a ≫ b) =
      GaloisEquivariantOver.precomp rho a (gluedQuotientOverHomEquiv rho T b) :=
  GaloisQuotientWitness.overHomEquiv_precomp
    (gluedGaloisQuotientWitness rho).toGaloisQuotientWitness a b

end StableAffineOpen

end AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent

+-/
+import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PicRepDatum
+import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.JacobianDataAbelSurj
+
+/-!
+# DJ-IN — the DAT-G → DAT-J handoff: a `PicRepDatum` at the challenge field is a `JacobianData`
+
+`informal/w4-datj-worksheet.md` §1.1/§0.9 pins the interface DAT-J consumes from DAT-G as
+**DJ-IN** = `PicRepDatum k k C`, and its §1.1 producer target reads
+
+```
+jacobianData C : JacobianData C where
+  J := (datGDatum C).J ; rep := (datGDatum C).rep
+  locallyOfFiniteType := (datGDatum C).lft ; quasiCompact := quasiCompact_jacobian C
+```
+
+with the note that *"every symbol on the RHS except `datGDatum` (DAT-G) and
+`quasiCompact_jacobian` (DJ-1) is landed"* and that the `rep :=` line needs **no adapter**
+because the two field types are definitionally equal (`Picard/PicRepDatum.lean`, the module's
+defeq smoke test).
+
+That packaging had never been written.  `PicRepDatum` occurs in no other Lean file in the
+tree: the defeq is recorded as an `example`, so nothing *consumes* it, and DAT-J's assembly
+was left as the pair (DAT-G output, qc) with no term joining them.  This file writes it.
+
+The content is exactly the interface, so it is short by design — but it is not nothing:
+writing it is what turns "DAT-G produces a datum over `k'`, and separately DAT-J wants one
+over `k`" into a single arrow, and it is what makes the remaining DAT-J debt *visibly* two
+statements (the DAT-G descent, and the quasi-compactness) rather than an unspecified
+assembly.
+
+## Main declarations
+
+* `AlgebraicGeometry.PicRepDatum.toJacobianData` — DJ-IN: a `PicRepDatum k k C` plus
+  quasi-compactness of its representing object is a `JacobianData C`, with `J`, `rep` and
+  `lft` carried across unchanged.
+* `AlgebraicGeometry.PicRepDatum.toJacobianData_J` / `_rep` — the two projections, `rfl`, so
+  a consumer never unfolds the packaging.
+* `AlgebraicGeometry.PicRepDatum.toJacobianDataOfAbelLifts` — the same with quasi-compactness
+  supplied in the shape the classical argument delivers it: per-point residue-field lifts of
+  an Abel morphism out of `DivScheme g` (`Picard/JacobianDataAbelSurj.lean`).
+
+## What this does NOT do
+
+It produces no `PicRepDatum`.  That is DAT-G/DAT-G0 — the finite-Galois descent from a
+finite separable stage, whose one avatar-less core is `Pic0PreservesFilteredBaseColimit`
+(`Picard/PicRepColimitCompat.lean`), and it is divRep-gated.  Nor does it produce the
+quasi-compactness or an Abel lift.  What it removes is the *assembly* step between them.
+-/
+
+set_option autoImplicit false
+set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
+
+universe u
+
+open CategoryTheory Limits
+
+namespace AlgebraicGeometry
+
+namespace PicRepDatum
+
+section Handoff
+
+variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
+  [IsProper C.hom] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
+
+/-- **DJ-IN, the DAT-G → DAT-J handoff** (w4-datj §1.1): a representability datum at the
+*challenge* field `k` — i.e. `PicRepDatum k k C`, the `k' = k` specialization of DAT-G's
+output — together with quasi-compactness of its representing object, is a `JacobianData C`.
+
+Three of the four fields are carried across verbatim.  The `rep` field needs **no adapter**:
+`(pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy J` and
+`((pic0Functor C ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat) ⋙ forget GrpCat).RepresentableBy J` are
+definitionally equal, which `Picard/PicRepDatum.lean`'s smoke test records and this
+definition is the first thing to actually *use*.
+
+Quasi-compactness is not stored by `PicRepDatum` on purpose (it is a-posteriori, via the
+Abel image — w4-datj §2.2), so it is the one argument here. -/
+noncomputable def toJacobianData (d : PicRepDatum k k C) (hqc : QuasiCompact d.J.hom) :
+    JacobianData C where
+  J := d.J
+  rep := d.rep
+  locallyOfFiniteType := d.lft
+  quasiCompact := hqc
+
+@[simp]
+lemma toJacobianData_J (d : PicRepDatum k k C) (hqc : QuasiCompact d.J.hom) :
+    (d.toJacobianData hqc).J = d.J :=
+  rfl
+
+@[simp]
+lemma toJacobianData_rep (d : PicRepDatum k k C) (hqc : QuasiCompact d.J.hom) :
+    (d.toJacobianData hqc).rep = d.rep :=
+  rfl
+
+/-! The group-object structure survives the DJ-IN packaging definitionally.  This is the
+headline-facing compatibility lemma: a consumer that activates `d.grpObj` before packaging
+can use the same structure after switching to `JacobianData`. -/
+@[simp]
+lemma toJacobianData_grpObj (d : PicRepDatum k k C) (hqc : QuasiCompact d.J.hom) :
+    (d.toJacobianData hqc).grpObj = d.grpObj :=
+  rfl
+
+/-- The universal properties agree: `JacobianData.homEquiv` of the packaged datum is
+`PicRepDatum.homEquiv` of the original.  Both accessors are `.rep.homEquiv`, so this is
+`rfl` — recorded so a consumer that switches between the two interfaces never needs a
+transport lemma. -/
+@[simp]
+lemma homEquiv_toJacobianData (d : PicRepDatum k k C) (hqc : QuasiCompact d.J.hom)
+    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} :
+    (d.toJacobianData hqc).homEquiv (T := T) = d.homEquiv (T := T) :=
+  rfl
+
+end Handoff
+
+/-! ## The handoff with quasi-compactness in its a-posteriori shape -/
+
+section AbelLifts
+
+variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
+  [IsProper C.hom] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
+variable {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
+  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [IsIntegral X]
+variable {A B : X.CurveDivisor} {g r₁ r₂ : ℕ}
+variable {b₁ : Module.Basis (Fin r₁) k ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k B ⊤)}
+variable {b₂ : Module.Basis (Fin r₂) k ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (A + B) ⊤)}
+

+`DivScheme g` admitting a residue-field lift at every point of `d.J.left` is a
+`JacobianData C`.
+

+quasi-compactness comes from the Abel image (w4-datj §2.2), never from the construction —
+`JacobianData`'s atlas is infinite (critical-path §7.5).  So the two remaining inputs of
+DAT-J are visible in this signature and nowhere else: a `PicRepDatum k k C`, and a lift. -/
+noncomputable def toJacobianDataOfAbelLifts (d : PicRepDatum k k C)
+    (abel : DivScheme k A B g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ ⟶ d.J.left)
+    (hlift : ∀ y : d.J.left, ∃ q : Spec (d.J.left.residueField y) ⟶
+      DivScheme k A B g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂,
+      q ≫ abel = d.J.left.fromSpecResidueField y) :
+    JacobianData C :=
+  d.toJacobianData
+    (quasiCompact_of_forall_residueField_lift_from_divScheme A B g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ d.J abel hlift)
+
+@[simp]
+lemma toJacobianDataOfAbelLifts_J (d : PicRepDatum k k C)
+    (abel : DivScheme k A B g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ ⟶ d.J.left)
+    (hlift : ∀ y : d.J.left, ∃ q : Spec (d.J.left.residueField y) ⟶
+      DivScheme k A B g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂,
+      q ≫ abel = d.J.left.fromSpecResidueField y) :
+    (d.toJacobianDataOfAbelLifts abel hlift).J = d.J :=
+  rfl
+
+end AbelLifts
+
+end PicRepDatum
+
+end AlgebraicGeometry

   209	      (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1 :=
   210	  (picRankOneOpenSigmaIso (C := C) h).hom ≫
   211	    picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl (divRepAffP1Map C) ≫
   212	      (sigmaExtensionIso (pic0GenusTranslationIso (C := C) a)).inv

   214	/-- Every translated rank-one chart is a representable open immersion. -/
   215	theorem picRankOneTranslatedChart_isOpenImmersion
   216	    (hopen : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen (divRepAffP1Map C))
   217	    (a : PicRankOneTranslatorIndex (C := C)) :
   218	    IsOpenImmersion.presheaf
   219	      (picRankOneTranslatedChart (C := C)
   220	        (divRankOneOpenDataOfPicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C) hopen) a) := by
   221	  apply MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderComposition.comp_mem
   222	  · apply MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderComposition.comp_mem
   223	    · exact MorphismProperty.of_isIso (P := IsOpenImmersion.presheaf) _
   224	    · exact MorphismProperty.of_isIso (P := IsOpenImmersion.presheaf) _
   225	  · apply MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderComposition.comp_mem
   226	    · exact hopen
   227	    · exact MorphismProperty.of_isIso (P := IsOpenImmersion.presheaf) _
   228	
   229	/-! ## Finiteness of the translated charts -/
   230	
   231	/-- The chosen genus divisor representer is locally of finite type over the base.  In positive
   232	genus it is definitionally a divisor scheme.  In genus zero, representer uniqueness transports
   233	the certificate from the terminal representer. -/
   234	theorem locallyOfFiniteType_divRepAffGenusScheme :
   235	    LocallyOfFiniteType (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom := by
   236	  by_cases hg : genus C = 0
   237	  · let D0 : Over (Spec (.of k)) := Over.mk (𝟙 (Spec (.of k)))
   238	    have rep0 : (divFunctorAff C (genus C)).RepresentableBy D0 := by
   239	      rw [hg]
   240	      exact divFunctorAffZeroRepresentableBy (C := C) (pi := divRepAffP1Map C)

--- 4 ---
   241	    let e := (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).uniqueUpToIso rep0
   242	    haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType D0.hom := by
   243	      change LocallyOfFiniteType (𝟙 (Spec (.of k)))
   244	      infer_instance
   245	    rw [← Over.w e.hom]
   246	    infer_instance
   247	  · unfold divRepAffGenusScheme divFunctorAffGenusRepresenter divRepAffScheme_at
   248	      divFunctorAffRepresenter_at
   249	    dsimp only
   250	    rw [dif_neg hg]
   251	    infer_instance

   253	/-- The certified rank-one divisor open is locally of finite type over the base field. -/
   254	theorem locallyOfFiniteType_divRankOneOpenOver
   255	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) (divRepAffP1Map C)) :
   256	    LocallyOfFiniteType (divRankOneOpenOver (divRepAffP1Map C) h).hom := by
   257	  change LocallyOfFiniteType
   258	    (divRankOneOpenMap (divRepAffP1Map C) h ≫ (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom)
   259	  letI : IsOpenImmersion (divRankOneOpenMap (divRepAffP1Map C) h) :=
   260	    divRankOneOpen_isOpenImmersion (divRepAffP1Map C) h
   261	  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (divRepAffGenusScheme C).hom :=
   262	    locallyOfFiniteType_divRepAffGenusScheme (C := C)
   263	  infer_instance

   265	/-- The structure map read from a translated rank-one chart is the structure map of its
   266	rank-one divisor-open source. -/
   267	lemma chartHom_picRankOneTranslatedChart
   268	    (h : DivRankOneOpenData (C := C) (divRepAffP1Map C))
   269	    (a : PicRankOneTranslatorIndex (C := C)) :
   270	    chartHom C (fun a : PicRankOneTranslatorIndex (C := C) =>
   271	      picRankOneTranslatedChart (C := C) h a) a =
   272	      (divRankOneOpenOver (divRepAffP1Map C) h).hom :=
   273	  rfl

   275	/-! ## From residue-field coverage to pointwise coverage -/
   276	
   277	/-- A family of representable open immersions covers pointwise as soon as it covers the class at
   278	every residue-field point.  Relative representability pulls a chosen field factorization back to
   279	an open immersion over the test; its open range is the required neighborhood. -/
   280	theorem pointwiseCoverage_of_residueField
   281	    {I : Type u} {X : I → Scheme.{u}}
   282	    (f : ∀ i, yoneda.obj (X i) ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1)
   283	    (hf : ∀ i, IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (f i))
   284	    (hfield : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (s : (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.obj (op T)) (t : T),
   285	      ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (q : Y) (y : Y ⟶ T) (i : I) (x : Y ⟶ X i),
   286	        y.base q = t ∧
   287	          (f i).app (op Y) x = (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.map y.op s) :
   288	    PointwiseCoverage C f := by
   289	  intro T s t
   290	  obtain ⟨Y, q, y, i, x, hyt, hx⟩ := hfield T s t
   291	  let g : yoneda.obj T ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1 := yonedaEquiv.symm s
   292	  obtain ⟨Z, snd, fst, hpb⟩ := (hf i).rep g
   293	  letI : IsOpenImmersion snd := (hf i).property g fst snd hpb
   294	  have hpbY := (IsPullback.iff_app.mp hpb) (op Y)
   295	  rw [Types.isPullback_iff] at hpbY
   296	  have hg : g.app (op Y) y = (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.map y.op s := by
   297	    exact yonedaEquiv_symm_app_apply s _ y
   298	  obtain ⟨z, hz₁, hz₂⟩ := hpbY.2.2 x y (hx.trans hg.symm)
   299	  let W : T.Opens := snd.opensRange
   300	  have htW : t ∈ W := by
   301	    change t ∈ snd.opensRange
   302	    apply Scheme.Hom.mem_opensRange.mpr
   303	    refine ⟨z.base q, ?_⟩
   304	    have hz := congrArg (fun m : Y ⟶ T => m.base q) hz₂
   305	    exact hz.trans hyt
   306	  refine ⟨W, htW, i, fst.app (op (W : Scheme.{u})) snd.isoOpensRange.inv, ?_⟩
   307	  have hpbW := (IsPullback.iff_app.mp hpb) (op (W : Scheme.{u}))
   308	  rw [Types.isPullback_iff] at hpbW
   309	  have hcomm := congrArg
   310	    (fun q => (ConcreteCategory.hom q) snd.isoOpensRange.inv) hpbW.1
   311	  change (f i).app (op (W : Scheme.{u}))
   312	      (fst.app (op (W : Scheme.{u})) snd.isoOpensRange.inv) = _
   313	  change (f i).app (op (W : Scheme.{u}))
   314	      (fst.app (op (W : Scheme.{u})) snd.isoOpensRange.inv) =
   315	    g.app (op (W : Scheme.{u})) (snd.isoOpensRange.inv ≫ snd) at hcomm
   316	  rw [Scheme.Hom.isoOpensRange_inv_comp] at hcomm
   317	  change (f i).app (op (W : Scheme.{u}))
   318	      (fst.app (op (W : Scheme.{u})) snd.isoOpensRange.inv) =
   319	    (yonedaEquiv.symm s).app (op (W : Scheme.{u})) W.ι at hcomm
   320	  rwa [yonedaEquiv_symm_app_apply] at hcomm
   321	
   322	/-! ## The separably closed field-point producer -/
   323	
   324	variable [IsSepClosed k]
   325	
   326	/-- Every degree-zero field class is hit by the translated chart indexed by the exact base class
   327	returned by `exists_sepClosedTranslated_mem_picRankOneOpen`. -/
   328	theorem exists_picRankOneTranslatedChart_fieldFactorization
   329	    (hopen : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen (divRepAffP1Map C))
   330	    {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
   331	    (mu : pic0Subgroup C (overSpec k K)) :
   332	    ∃ (a : PicRankOneTranslatorIndex (C := C))
   333	      (x : (overSpec k K).left ⟶
   334	        (divRankOneOpenOver (divRepAffP1Map C)
   335	          (divRankOneOpenDataOfPicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C) hopen)).left),
   336	      (picRankOneTranslatedChart (C := C)
   337	          (divRankOneOpenDataOfPicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C) hopen) a).app
   338	        (op (overSpec k K).left) x =
   339	          (⟨(overSpec k K).hom, mu⟩ :
   340	            (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.obj (op (overSpec k K).left)) := by
   341	  obtain ⟨L, hLfield, hkL, hKL, htow, hfin, hsep, d, r, hdeg, hsupp, hmem⟩ :=
   342	    exists_sepClosedTranslated_mem_picRankOneOpen
   343	      (C := C) (divRepAffP1Map C) (divRepAffP1Map_comp C) mu
   344	  letI := hLfield
   345	  letI := hkL
   346	  letI := hKL
   347	  letI := htow
   348	  letI := hfin
   349	  letI := hsep
   350	  let a : PicRankOneTranslatorIndex (C := C) :=
   351	    ⟨chartTwistClass C d.m r.Z, hdeg⟩
   352	  let baseValue : (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.obj (op (overSpec k K).left) :=
   353	    ⟨(overSpec k K).hom, mu⟩
   354	  let translatedValue :=
   355	    (sigmaExtensionIso (pic0GenusTranslationIso (C := C) a)).hom.app
   356	      (op (overSpec k K).left) baseValue
   357	  have htranslated : translatedValue.2 = r.rankOneLayer mu.1 d := by
   358	    apply Subtype.ext
   359	    change mu.1 * thetaFamily C (chartTwistClass C d.m r.Z) (overSpec k K) = _
   360	    rw [SepClosedTranslatedDropResult.rankOneLayer_coe]
   361	  have htranslatedMem : translatedValue.2 ∈
   362	      (PicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C)).obj (op (overSpec k K)) := by
   363	    rw [htranslated]
   364	    exact hmem
   365	  let v : (rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := divRepAffP1Map C)).obj
   366	      (op (overSpec k K).left) :=
   367	    ⟨translatedValue.1, ⟨translatedValue.2, htranslatedMem⟩⟩
   368	  let e := picRankOneOpenSigmaIso (C := C)
   369	    (divRankOneOpenDataOfPicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C) hopen)
   370	  refine ⟨a, e.inv.app (op (overSpec k K).left) v, ?_⟩
   371	  change (sigmaExtensionIso (pic0GenusTranslationIso (C := C) a)).inv.app _
   372	      ((picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl (divRepAffP1Map C)).app _
   373	        (e.hom.app _ (e.inv.app _ v))) = baseValue
   374	  rw [e.inv_hom_id_app_apply]
   375	  change (sigmaExtensionIso (pic0GenusTranslationIso (C := C) a)).inv.app _
   376	      translatedValue = baseValue
   377	  exact (sigmaExtensionIso (pic0GenusTranslationIso (C := C) a)).hom_inv_id_app_apply
   378	    _ baseValue
   379	
   380	/-! ## Pointwise coverage and representability -/
   381	
   382	set_option maxHeartbeats 800000 in
   383	-- Elaborating the residue-field specialization crosses both sigma-extension dependent fibres.
   384	/-- The translated rank-one charts cover the sigma extension pointwise.  At a point `t`,
   385	restrict the degree-zero class to `Spec κ(t)`, use the exact separably-closed translated
   386	rank-one factorization there, and take the whole residue-field point as the covering source. -/
   387	theorem picRankOneTranslatedChart_pointwiseCoverage
   388	    (hopen : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen (divRepAffP1Map C)) :
   389	    PointwiseCoverage C (fun a : PicRankOneTranslatorIndex (C := C) =>
   390	      picRankOneTranslatedChart (C := C)
   391	        (divRankOneOpenDataOfPicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C) hopen) a) := by
   392	  apply pointwiseCoverage_of_residueField (C := C)
   393	  · exact fun a => picRankOneTranslatedChart_isOpenImmersion (C := C) hopen a
   394	  · intro T s t
   395	    rcases s with ⟨b, mu⟩
   396	    let Tbar : Over (Spec (.of k)) := Over.mk b
   397	    let K := Over.testPointField (T := Tbar) t
   398	    let p : overSpec k K ⟶ Tbar := Over.testPoint (T := Tbar) t
   399	    let muK : pic0Subgroup C (overSpec k K) := (pic0TypeFunctor C).map p.op mu
   400	    obtain ⟨a, x, hx⟩ :=
   401	      exists_picRankOneTranslatedChart_fieldFactorization (C := C) hopen muK
   402	    let q : (overSpec k K).left := Classical.choice inferInstance
   403	    have hq : p.left.base q = t := by
   404	      dsimp only [p]
   405	      exact Over.testPoint_base (T := Tbar) t q
   406	    refine ⟨(overSpec k K).left, q, p.left, a, x, ?_, ?_⟩
   407	    · exact hq
   408	    · exact hx.trans (Over.sigmaExtension_map_left_mk p mu).symm
   409	
   410	/-- Over a separably closed field, openness of the rank-one Picard locus gives a scheme
   411	representing `Pic^0`.  This conditional form keeps the geometric gluing argument reusable. -/
   412	noncomputable def pic0_sepClosed_representableBy_of_isOpen
   413	    (hopen : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen (divRepAffP1Map C)) :
   414	    Σ J : Over (Spec (.of k)), (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy J := by
   415	  let h := divRankOneOpenDataOfPicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C) hopen
   416	  let f := fun a : PicRankOneTranslatorIndex (C := C) =>
   417	    picRankOneTranslatedChart (C := C) h a
   418	  letI : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.zariskiTopology (Sigma.desc f) :=
   419	    isLocallySurjective_sigmaDesc_of_pointwise C f
   420	      (picRankOneTranslatedChart_pointwiseCoverage (C := C) hopen)
   421	  exact ⟨_, pic0RepresentableByOfCharts C f
   422	    (fun a => picRankOneTranslatedChart_isOpenImmersion (C := C) hopen a)⟩
   423	
   424	/-- Over a separably closed field, `Pic^0` is represented by the scheme obtained by gluing the
   425	translated canonical rank-one Abel charts. -/
   426	noncomputable def pic0_sepClosed_representableBy :
   427	    Σ J : Over (Spec (.of k)), (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy J :=
   428	  pic0_sepClosed_representableBy_of_isOpen
   429	    (C := C) (picRankOneOpen_isOpen (divRepAffP1Map C) (divRepAffP1Map_comp C))
   430	
   431	/-- The exact separably closed representing scheme constructed above is locally of finite type
   432	over the base field. -/
   433	theorem locallyOfFiniteType_pic0_sepClosed_representableBy :
   434	    LocallyOfFiniteType (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1.hom := by
   435	  let hopen := picRankOneOpen_isOpen (C := C)
   436	    (divRepAffP1Map C) (divRepAffP1Map_comp C)
   437	  let h := divRankOneOpenDataOfPicRankOneOpen (divRepAffP1Map C) hopen
   438	  let f := fun a : PicRankOneTranslatorIndex (C := C) =>
   439	    picRankOneTranslatedChart (C := C) h a
   440	  let hf := fun a : PicRankOneTranslatorIndex (C := C) =>
   441	    picRankOneTranslatedChart_isOpenImmersion (C := C) hopen a
   442	  letI : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.zariskiTopology (Sigma.desc f) :=
   443	    isLocallySurjective_sigmaDesc_of_pointwise C f
   444	      (picRankOneTranslatedChart_pointwiseCoverage (C := C) hopen)
   445	  change LocallyOfFiniteType (gluedHom C f hf)
   446	  apply locallyOfFiniteType_gluedHom C f hf
   447	  intro a
   448	  rw [chartHom_picRankOneTranslatedChart]
   449	  exact locallyOfFiniteType_divRankOneOpenOver h
   450	
   451	end
   452	
   453	end AlgebraicGeometry

/-!
# Narrow root for the AJCR-first Picard strategy

This root deliberately imports only the current route modules and contracts. Every later
contract endpoint must be checked here before it receives critical-path credit.

The tied local rank-one presentation, its canonical evaluation map, datum-side local-away
divisor equations, and the pullback-stable presentation locus are present. The conditional
`DivRankOneOpenData` representer and its open-immersion/base-change consumers are rooted. The
native evaluation section and the tied datum section have the same restriction-vanishing
predicate on every open, without a Noetherian hypothesis; their piece coordinates and principal
piece ideals agree, and those native-coordinate ideals commute with arbitrary affine
coefficient extension.

The native rank-one route now closes from certificates to public membership on the field fibre.
`RankOneFamilyCertificates.ofActualDatum` produces all four family certificates from a single
per-residue-field H1 witness plus a fibre class-degree law, with rank one computed
Noetherian-freely by `rankAtStalk_hModule_zero_eq_one_of_actualPairH1`. Arbitrary-cartesian
native base change is internalized by `isIso_canonicalBaseChangeMap_nativeModule`, so
`ofCertificatesWithNativeBaseChange` and `ofLocalPresentation` build native presentations with
no extra base-change certificate. Consequently `mem_picRankOneOpen_of_isSplitWitness` places
every split genus-degree field class in `PicRankOneOpen`, and the Pic0 separably closed
translated-cover feeder lands its translated layer element in the public locus:
`exists_sepClosedTranslated_mem_picRankOneOpen` is the phase-5 membership endpoint.

On the divisor side, the tied local presentation's finite principal-open evaluation divisors
glue: `exists_glued_rankOne_away_divisor_with_abel_evaluation` produces a `DivFamZarAff` over
the Noetherian etale carrier with the global Abel and relative-Picard identities, resting on
`baseOpenRankOneDivisor_awayMul_compat`. The big-site consumer scaffold reduces
`PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen` to one canonical evaluation-divisor classifier and per-test pullback
squares: `picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_evaluationDivisorPullbackFamilies`.

The glued divisor now descends: `existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_localPresentation` consumes
the finite-glue output and returns the unique Abel-correct `DivFamZarAff` over the original
affine base, conditional only on the named `RankOneDivisorUniqueness` interface (the
tensor-square cocycle is manufactured from uniqueness, the descended class is pinned by étale
separatedness); `canonicalRankOneDivisorOfPresentation` names that divisor. Toward discharging
the uniqueness interface, `exists_notMem_cechPicMap_eq_of_relPicMk_eq` localizes
`relPicMk`-equality to on-the-nose `picClass` equality near every prime (base Picard classes
die Zariski-locally). The public locus is fibrewise split:
`mem_picRankOneOpen_iff_isSplitWitness` at field bases, and
`isSplitWitness_testPoint_of_mem` at every point of an arbitrary test.

Fibre nonvanishing toward that discharge is landed:
`sectionsMapTop_ne_zero_of_divEq_certified` and its tensor-form consumer say a datum section
cutting a certified divisor is nonzero on every residue-field fibre — the exact input shape of
the rank-one unit-extraction engine.

Datum-section extraction is landed, Noetherian-free:
`exists_gluedSection_sectionLocalEquations_divEq` cuts any `LocalEquations` divisor whose
Picard class matches the datum's Čech class from a germ-regular global section of the glued
sheaf, up to `DivEq` on every subordinated pointed cover — the α-corrected gluing through the
glued sheaf's own sheaf property; and `sectionLocalEquations_smul_divEq` records that global
unit rescalings of the section do not move the cut divisor.

The uniqueness interface is now DISCHARGED: `divFamZarAff_eq_of_picClass_eq_cechPicClass`
proves at most one certified divisor family per rank-one datum class (extraction + fibre
nonvanishing + the unit-extraction engine), and `rankOneDivisorUniqueness` assembles it with
the base-discrepancy localization, away-span separatedness, and faithfully-flat descent into
an unconditional proof of `RankOneDivisorUniqueness`. The canonical rank-one divisor and its
Abel/uniqueness accessors are re-exported without the interface hypothesis
(`canonicalRankOneDivisor`).

The Abel inverse law is also discharged: `divFamZarAff_eq_of_rankOne` upgrades the affine
uniqueness to arbitrary tests through the vehicle's affine-open separatedness, so the
restricted Abel map is componentwise injective on the big site
(`rankOneAbelSigma_app_injective`) and every evaluation-divisor classifier is automatically a
two-sided inverse (`abelInverse_of_uniqueness`); `rankOneAbelIso` packages the isomorphism,
gated only on an inhabitant of `PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData`.

The noetherian-free canonical divisor theorem is now integrated at family level:
`canonicalRankOneSection` is natural on every test scheme, its representer transport is
`canonicalRankOneRepresenterTrans`, and `canonicalRankOneEvaluationDivisorData` is a genuine
inhabitant of the evaluator contract.  The finite-stage degree, admissibility, glued-divisor,
carrier transport, arbitrary-affine canonical divisor, and family integration milestones are
independently kernel-checked.  Consequently `canonicalRankOneAbelIso` is a root-reachable
two-sided inverse to the restricted Abel map on the big site.

The geometric open-locus producer is now unconditional.  `picRankOneSplitLocus` is open on an
arbitrary test, pointwise splitting constructs the native presentation of the same pulled-back
class, and `picRankOneOpen_fibrePresented` identifies this open with the pullback of the public
rank-one locus along an arbitrary Yoneda family.  Thus `picRankOneOpen_isOpen`, specialized to
`divRepAffP1Map C`, supplies the actual `DivRankOneOpenData` consumed by the canonical Abel chart.

The generic finite-Galois quotient engine is also complete through non-affine stable-chart
gluing.  `galoisQuotientWitnessOfInvariantProjection` supplies the effective universal
property, while `StableAffineOpen.isGaloisQuotient_glued` and
`StableAffineOpen.hasGaloisQuotient_of_orbitsInAffineOpen` construct the quotient under the
honest orbit-in-affine-open condition.  This does not manufacture that condition for a Picard
representer or identify quotient points with `pic0`.

The separably closed endpoint is now complete.  The exact translator returned by
`exists_sepClosedTranslated_mem_picRankOneOpen` indexes a translated canonical Abel chart;
these charts are open immersions and cover every residue-field point.  Consequently
`pic0_sepClosed_representableBy` is unconditional and represents the same pinned
`pic0TypeFunctor` over every separably closed base field.

Still missing, and NOT replaced here by axioms or local hypotheses: the finite-stage spread,
the Picard-specific Galois quotient comparison, `pic0_representableBy`, and `JacobianData`
endpoints.
-/

     8	/-!
     9	# Application formulas for the admissible widened Abel map
    10	
    11	This file isolates the map-level equalities needed after a widened divisor family has been
    12	constructed on an affine test. It exposes the chart datum chosen inside the admissible map,
    13	computes a represented point under the Sigma-extended Abel transformation, identifies the
    14	affine Abel value after the vehicle collapse, and packages the final cancellation of the
    15	fixed chart twists.
    16	
    17	No quotient, atlas, or representability conclusion is asserted here.
    18	-/
    19	
    20	set_option autoImplicit false
    21	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    22	
    23	universe u
    24	
    25	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory Opposite
    26	
    27	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    28	
    29	attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    30	
    31	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    32	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    33	variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    34	
    35	noncomputable section
    36	
    37	variable (C) in
    38	/-- The chart index and divisor chosen inside the admissible Abel map can be exposed without
    39	choosing new data. The equality is definitional after unfolding the admissible map. -/
    40	theorem exists_abelSigmaChartAffAdmissible_eq :
    41	    ∃ (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
    42	      (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
    43	        = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C)
    44	          - (divRepAffAdmissibleParameter C : ℤ)),
    45	      abelSigmaChartAffAdmissible C =
    46	        abelSigmaChartAff C (divRepAffAdmissibleParameter C)
    47	          (divFunctorAff_admissible_representableBy C) m Z hdeg := by
    48	  dsimp only [abelSigmaChartAffAdmissible]
    49	  exact ⟨_, _, _, rfl⟩
    50	
    51	variable {n : ℕ}
    52	
    53	/-- Classifying a section with a representer and then evaluating the Sigma-extended Abel map
    54	at the underlying scheme morphism returns the original section's chart value. The equality of
    55	the two structure morphisms is handled by sigma-extension extensionality. -/
    56	theorem abelSigmaChartAff_app_homEquiv_symm
    57	    {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    58	    (rep : (divFunctorAff C n).RepresentableBy D)
    59	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
    60	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
    61	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (n : ℤ))
    62	    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (a : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    63	    (s : divFamZarAff C n (Over.mk a)) :
    64	    let q := rep.homEquiv.symm s
    65	    (abelSigmaChartAff C n rep m Z hdeg).app (op Y) q.left =
    66	      (⟨a, (chartValueAffTrans C n m Z hdeg).app (op (Over.mk a)) s⟩ :
    67	        (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.obj (op Y)) := by
    68	  let q := rep.homEquiv.symm s
    69	  change (abelSigmaChartAff C n rep m Z hdeg).app (op Y) q.left =
    70	    (⟨a, (chartValueAffTrans C n m Z hdeg).app (op (Over.mk a)) s⟩ :
    71	      (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.obj (op Y))
    72	  change (⟨q.left ≫ D.hom, _⟩ :
    73	      (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.obj (op Y)) =
    74	    ⟨a, (chartValueAffTrans C n m Z hdeg).app (op (Over.mk a)) s⟩
    75	  refine Over.sigmaExtension_ext (pic0TypeFunctor C) q.w ?_
    76	  let e := Over.mkCongr q.w
    77	  let q' : Over.mk (q.left ≫ D.hom) ⟶ D :=
    78	    Over.homMk (U := Over.mk (q.left ≫ D.hom)) q.left
    79	  change (pic0TypeFunctor C).map e.op
    80	      ((chartValueAffTrans C n m Z hdeg).app (op (Over.mk a)) s) =
    81	    (chartValueAffTrans C n m Z hdeg).app
    82	      (op (Over.mk (q.left ≫ D.hom))) (rep.homEquiv q')
    83	  have hhom : e ≫ q = q' := by
    84	    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    85	    exact Category.id_comp _
    86	  have hq : rep.homEquiv q = s := by
    87	    dsimp only [q]
    88	    exact Equiv.apply_symm_apply rep.homEquiv s
    89	  have hfamily : rep.homEquiv q' =
    90	      (divFunctorAff C n).map e.op s := by
    91	    calc
    92	      rep.homEquiv q' = rep.homEquiv (e ≫ q) := congrArg rep.homEquiv hhom.symm
    93	      _ = (divFunctorAff C n).map e.op (rep.homEquiv q) := rep.homEquiv_comp e q
    94	      _ = (divFunctorAff C n).map e.op s := congrArg _ hq
    95	  have hnat := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom
    96	    ((chartValueAffTrans C n m Z hdeg).naturality e.op) s
    97	  calc
    98	    _ = (chartValueAffTrans C n m Z hdeg).app
    99	        (op (Over.mk (q.left ≫ D.hom))) ((divFunctorAff C n).map e.op s) := by
   100	      simpa only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] using hnat.symm
   101	    _ = _ := congrArg _ hfamily.symm
   102	
   103	omit [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] in
   104	/-- On an affine test, passing a widened affine family through the inverse vehicle comparison
   105	and then taking its Abel value recovers the direct affine Abel value. -/
   106	theorem picEtAffineEquiv_abelDivAff'_affineEquiv_symm
   107	    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] (F : DivFamZarAff C A n) :
   108	    picEtAffineEquiv C A
   109	        (abelDivAff' C n (overSpec k A) ((divFamZarAffAffineEquiv C n A).symm F))
   110	      = abelDivAffPlus C A F := by
   111	  rw [picEtAffineEquiv_abelDivAff', Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
   112	
   113	/-- If the Abel value of a widened family is the inverse chart twist of a target degree-zero
   114	class, then the chart transformation sends that family to the target itself. -/
   115	theorem chartValueAffTrans_app_eq_of_abelDivAff'_eq_chartTwist
   116	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   117	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
   118	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (n : ℤ))
   119	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (s : divFamZarAff C n T)
   120	    (lam : pic0Subgroup C T)
   121	    (habel : abelDivAff' C n T s = chartTwist C m Z T lam.1) :
   122	    (chartValueAffTrans C n m Z hdeg).app (op T) s = lam := by
   123	  apply Subtype.ext
   124	  rw [chartValueAffTrans_app_coe]
   125	  change chartValueAff C n m Z T s = lam.1
   126	  rw [chartValueAff, habel, chartTwist]
   127	  group
   128	
   129	end
   130	
   131	end AlgebraicGeometry

     9	/-!
    10	# Etale-site reduction and affine PicEt honestification
    11	
    12	This file provides the site-theoretic and affine-plus infrastructure used to turn affine
    13	local lifts into local surjectivity on the big etale site. It also packages the passage from
    14	an affine `picEt` class to an honest relative Picard class after restriction to the carrier of
    15	one of its etale presentations.
    16	
    17	The declarations here are independent of the Abel transformation and make no representability
    18	or quotient assertion.
    19	-/
    20	
    21	set_option autoImplicit false
    22	
    23	universe u
    24	
    25	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
    26	
    27	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    28	
    29	noncomputable section
    30	
    31	/-! ## Reduction to affine tests -/
    32	
    33	/-- A sieve on a scheme is etale-covering if its pullback to every member of the canonical
    34	affine open cover is etale-covering. -/
    35	theorem mem_etaleTopology_of_pullback_affine {T : Scheme.{u}} (S : Sieve T)
    36	    (h : ∀ (j : T.affineCover.I₀), S.pullback (T.affineCover.f j) ∈
    37	      Scheme.etaleTopology (T.affineCover.X j)) :
    38	    S ∈ Scheme.etaleTopology T := by
    39	  have hcov : (Sieve.generate (Presieve.ofArrows T.affineCover.X T.affineCover.f))
    40	      ∈ Scheme.etaleTopology T := by
    41	    apply Scheme.zariskiTopology_le_etaleTopology
    42	    exact Scheme.mem_grothendieckTopology_iff.mpr
    43	      ⟨T.affineCover, Sieve.le_generate _⟩
    44	  refine Scheme.etaleTopology.transitive hcov S ?_
    45	  rintro Y g ⟨V, a, b, ⟨j⟩, rfl⟩
    46	  rw [Sieve.pullback_comp]
    47	  exact Scheme.etaleTopology.pullback_stable a (h j)
    48	
    49	/-- To prove local surjectivity on the big etale site, it suffices to produce an etale cover
    50	with local lifts over every affine test scheme. -/
    51	theorem isLocallySurjective_etale_of_affine
    52	    {F G : Scheme.{u}ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : F ⟶ G)
    53	    (h : ∀ (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine Y] (s : G.obj (op Y)),
    54	      ∃ (cover : Y.Cover.{u} (Scheme.precoverage @Etale)),
    55	        ∀ j : cover.I₀, ∃ x : F.obj (op (cover.X j)),
    56	          f.app (op (cover.X j)) x = G.map (cover.f j).op s) :
    57	    Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.etaleTopology f where
    58	  imageSieve_mem {U} s := by
    59	    apply mem_etaleTopology_of_pullback_affine
    60	    intro j
    61	    rw [Presheaf.pullback_imageSieve]
    62	    obtain ⟨cover, hcover⟩ :=
    63	      h (U.affineCover.X j) (G.map (U.affineCover.f j).op s)
    64	    refine (Scheme.mem_grothendieckTopology_iff (P := @Etale)).mpr ⟨cover, ?_⟩
    65	    rintro Y g ⟨i⟩
    66	    exact hcover i
    67	
    68	/-! ## Covers induced by affine etale presentations -/
    69	
    70	/-- The spectrum of the carrier of an algebraic etale cover is a singleton etale cover of
    71	the spectrum of the base algebra. -/
    72	noncomputable def etaleSchemeCover {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    73	    (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A) :
    74	    (Spec (.of A)).Cover (Scheme.precoverage @Etale) :=
    75	  Scheme.Cover.mkOfCovers PUnit (fun _ => Spec (.of E.Carrier))
    76	    (fun _ => Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A E.Carrier)))
    77	    (fun x => by
    78	      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := E.comap_surjective x
    79	      exact ⟨PUnit.unit, y, hy⟩)
    80	    (fun _ => by
    81	      rw [HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @Etale)]
    82	      exact RingHom.etale_algebraMap.mpr inferInstance)
    83	
    84	/-! ## Honestification of affine PicEt classes -/
    85	
    86	namespace PicEtAff
    87	
    88	/-- `mapAlg` agrees with the instance-based affine restriction map when the underlying ring
    89	homomorphism is the chosen `A`-algebra structure on `B`. -/
    90	theorem mapAlg_eq_map_of_toRingHom_eq_algebraMap
    91	    {k A B : Type u} [Field k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [CommRing B]
    92	    [Algebra k B] [Algebra A B] [IsScalarTower k A B]
    93	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) (phi : A →ₐ[k] B)
    94	    (hphi : phi.toRingHom = algebraMap A B) (a : PicEtAff C A) :
    95	    PicEtAff.mapAlg C phi a = PicEtAff.map C B a := by
    96	  have hAlg : phi.toRingHom.toAlgebra = (inferInstance : Algebra A B) :=
    97	    Algebra.algebra_ext _ _ fun r => by
    98	      change phi r = algebraMap A B r
    99	      exact DFunLike.congr_fun hphi r
   100	  unfold PicEtAff.mapAlg
   101	  subst hAlg
   102	  rfl
   103	
   104	/-- Restricting an affine PicEt presentation along the map to its own cover carrier produces
   105	the honest class represented by its descent datum. -/
   106	theorem mapAlg_mk_eq_unit_self
   107	    {k A : Type u} [Field k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   108	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   109	    (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A) (x : descentClasses C E) :
   110	    PicEtAff.mapAlg C ((Algebra.ofId A E.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
   111	        (PicEtAff.mk C E x)
   112	      = PicEtAff.unit C E.Carrier
   113	          (x : relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier)) := by
   114	  rw [mapAlg_eq_map_of_toRingHom_eq_algebraMap C _ rfl]
   115	  exact PicEtAff.map_mk_eq_unit_self C E x
   116	
   117	end PicEtAff
   118	
   119	/-- On affine tests, restricting a `picEt` class to the carrier of one of its plus
   120	presentations agrees with the `picEt` unit of the corresponding honest relative Picard
   121	class. -/
   122	theorem picEtMap_eq_relPicToPicEt_of_affineRepresentative
   123	    {k A : Type u} [Field k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   124	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   125	    [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [GeometricallyReduced C.hom]
   126	    (lam : picEt C (overSpec k A)) (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A)
   127	    (x : descentClasses C E)
   128	    (h : picEtAffineEquiv C A lam = PicEtAff.mk C E x) :
   129	    picEtMap C
   130	        (Over.overSpecMap ((Algebra.ofId A E.Carrier).restrictScalars k)) lam
   131	      = relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k E.Carrier)
   132	          (x : relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier)) := by
   133	  apply (picEtAffineEquiv C E.Carrier).injective
   134	  rw [picEtAffineEquiv_naturality, h,
   135	    picEtAffineEquiv_relPicToPicEt,
   136	    PicEtAff.mapAlg_mk_eq_unit_self]
   137	
   138	end
   139	
   140	end AlgebraicGeometry

     8	/-!
     9	# Etale covers from pointwise prime lifts
    10	
    11	This file packages the cover used in the affine callback for admissible Abel
    12	surjectivity.  Starting from a singleton affine etale cover, every prime of its
    13	carrier is allowed a further, independently chosen etale algebra carrying a
    14	prime above it.  The resulting spectra jointly cover the original affine test
    15	scheme.
    16	-/
    17	
    18	set_option autoImplicit false
    19	
    20	universe u
    21	
    22	open CategoryTheory
    23	
    24	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    25	
    26	noncomputable section
    27	
    28	attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra
    29	
    30	variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
    31	variable (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : T.left.affineOpens)
    32	variable (E : Algebra.EtaleCover Γ(T.left, U.1))
    33	variable (S : PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier → Type u)
    34	variable [∀ p, CommRing (S p)] [∀ p, Algebra E.Carrier (S p)]
    35	variable [∀ p, Algebra.Etale E.Carrier (S p)]
    36	
    37	/-- The over-category morphism underlying the member indexed by `p` of the
    38	pointwise prime-lift cover. -/
    39	noncomputable def etalePrimeLiftOverHom
    40	    [∀ p, Algebra k (S p)] [∀ p, IsScalarTower k E.Carrier (S p)]
    41	    (p : PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier) :
    42	    overSpec k (S p) ⟶ T :=
    43	  Over.overSpecMap (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k E.Carrier (S p)) ≫
    44	    Over.overSpecMap (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k Γ(T.left, U.1) E.Carrier) ≫
    45	      Over.fromSpecAffine T U
    46	
    47	/-- Etale spectra carrying chosen lifts of all primes of a singleton etale
    48	presentation form an etale cover of the original affine-open test object.
    49	
    50	The hypothesis `hU` is the only place affineness of the target is used: it says
    51	that the chosen affine open is the whole target. -/
    52	noncomputable def etalePrimeLiftCover (hU : U.1 = ⊤)
    53	    (q : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier, PrimeSpectrum (S p))
    54	    (hq : ∀ p, PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap E.Carrier (S p)) (q p) = p) :
    55	    T.left.Cover (Scheme.precoverage @Etale) :=
    56	  Scheme.Cover.mkOfCovers (PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier)
    57	    (fun p ↦ Spec (.of (S p)))
    58	    (fun p ↦
    59	      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap E.Carrier (S p))) ≫
    60	        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
    61	          (algebraMap Γ(T.left, U.1) E.Carrier)) ≫
    62	          (Over.fromSpecAffine T U).left)
    63	    (fun x ↦ by
    64	      have hx : x ∈ Set.range U.2.fromSpec.base := by
    65	        rw [U.2.range_fromSpec, hU]
    66	        trivial
    67	      obtain ⟨xA, hxA⟩ := hx
    68	      obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := E.comap_surjective xA
    69	      refine ⟨p, q p, ?_⟩
    70	      change U.2.fromSpec.base
    71	          (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap Γ(T.left, U.1) E.Carrier)
    72	            (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap E.Carrier (S p)) (q p))) = x
    73	      rw [hq p, hp]
    74	      exact hxA)
    75	    (fun p ↦ by
    76	      haveI : Etale
    77	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap E.Carrier (S p)))) := by
    78	        rw [HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @Etale)]
    79	        exact RingHom.etale_algebraMap.mpr inferInstance
    80	      haveI : Etale
    81	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
    82	            (algebraMap Γ(T.left, U.1) E.Carrier))) := by
    83	        rw [HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @Etale)]
    84	        exact RingHom.etale_algebraMap.mpr inferInstance
    85	      haveI : IsOpenImmersion (Over.fromSpecAffine T U).left :=
    86	        U.2.isOpenImmersion_fromSpec
    87	      change Etale
    88	        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap E.Carrier (S p))) ≫
    89	          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
    90	            (algebraMap Γ(T.left, U.1) E.Carrier)) ≫
    91	            (Over.fromSpecAffine T U).left)
    92	      exact MorphismProperty.comp_mem @Etale _ _ inferInstance
    93	        (MorphismProperty.comp_mem @Etale _ _ inferInstance
    94	          (HasRingHomProperty.of_isOpenImmersion
    95	            RingHom.Etale.containsIdentities)))
    96	
    97	set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false
    98	
    99	/-- Every member morphism of `etalePrimeLiftCover` is definitionally the left
   100	leg of the corresponding over-category composite. -/
   101	@[simp]
   102	theorem etalePrimeLiftCover_f (hU : U.1 = ⊤)
   103	    [∀ p, Algebra k (S p)] [∀ p, IsScalarTower k E.Carrier (S p)]
   104	    (q : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier, PrimeSpectrum (S p))
   105	    (hq : ∀ p, PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap E.Carrier (S p)) (q p) = p)
   106	    (p : PrimeSpectrum E.Carrier) :
   107	    (etalePrimeLiftCover T U E S hU q hq).f p =
   108	      (etalePrimeLiftOverHom T U E S p).left :=
   109	  rfl
   110	
   111	end

    32	attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    33	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver

    42	-- The chosen chart unfolds the uniform coverage witnesses and their finiteness instances.
    43	/-- The chart fixed inside the admissible Abel transformation covers every Pic0 class. -/
    44	theorem chartLocus_admissibleAbelChart_eq_univ
    45	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (lam : pic0Subgroup C T) :
    46	    chartLocus C (admissibleAbelChartIndex C)
    47	      (admissibleAbelChartDivisor C) lam.1 = Set.univ := by

    49	  letI : C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := .ofHom C.hom

    51	    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
    52	  haveI : IsIntegral C.left := isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced C
    53	  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
    54	    inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType C.hom)

    56	    inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact C.hom)
    57	  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0) :=
    58	    moduleFinite_hModule_zero C
    59	  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1) :=
    60	    moduleFinite_hModule_one C

    62	    (C := C) (divRepAffP1Map_comp C) (genus C)
    63	      (chi_moduleKSheaf C)).choose_spec.choose_spec.2 lam
